tables.name: waitlist_signups
tables.purpose: Records every shopper email against the specific variant (or product-level fallback) they want to be notified about when it returns to stock.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: shopper_email
columns.purpose: email address submitted by the shopper; no customer account required

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: the specific variant the shopper is waiting on; for single-variant products this is the default variant id

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: the parent product; used for product-deletion cascade and dashboard grouping

columns.name: product_title
columns.purpose: denormalized at signup time so emails render correctly even if the product is later edited

columns.name: variant_title
columns.purpose: denormalized at signup time for the same reason as product_title

columns.name: product_url
columns.purpose: storefront URL denormalized at signup so the notification email can include a direct link

columns.name: unsubscribe_token
columns.purpose: unique token embedded in every email's one-click unsubscribe link

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: active | notified | unsubscribed | purged

columns.name: signed_up_at
columns.purpose: FIFO queue ordering — earlier timestamps are notified first during partial restocks

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.purpose: soft-delete timestamp set when the parent product is deleted

tables.name: variant_availability
tables.purpose: Tracks the last-observed availability state of each variant so the system can detect true restock transitions and prevent duplicate notification runs when stock briefly dips.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: the variant whose availability is being observed

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: parent product for cascade deletes

columns.name: availability_state
columns.purpose: last observed state: out_of_stock | available

columns.name: last_out_of_stock_at
columns.purpose: timestamp of the most recent out-of-stock transition; used to gate notification run dedup — a run is only created if it was created after this timestamp

columns.name: last_available_at
columns.purpose: timestamp of the most recent in-stock transition

tables.name: notification_runs
tables.purpose: Represents one restock event for a variant — the batch of sends triggered when that variant came back in stock.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: the variant that triggered this run

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: parent product for dashboard grouping

columns.name: product_title
columns.purpose: denormalized from the in-stock event for historical display

columns.name: variant_title
columns.purpose: denormalized from the in-stock event for historical display

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: open | completed | cancelled

columns.name: available_units
columns.purpose: inventory quantity at the time the restock was detected; determines how many signups to select from the front of the queue

columns.name: sends_enqueued
columns.purpose: number of notification sends created for this run

columns.name: sends_dispatched
columns.purpose: pre-aggregated count of dispatched sends for the history dashboard

columns.name: sends_failed
columns.purpose: pre-aggregated count of failed sends for the history dashboard

columns.name: conversions
columns.purpose: pre-aggregated count of attributed purchases within 7 days for lost-demand-recovered metric

tables.name: notification_sends
tables.purpose: One row per individual email send attempt within a notification run; drives the delivery queue and attribution lookups.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: run_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the parent notification run

columns.name: signup_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES waitlist_signups(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the waitlist signup being notified

columns.name: shopper_email
columns.purpose: denormalized for fast attribution queries without joining to signups

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: denormalized for fast attribution queries

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: enqueued | dispatched | failed | held_quiet_hours

columns.name: converted
columns.purpose: true when a paid order attributed this send within the 7-day window

tables.name: conversion_events
tables.purpose: Records each attributed purchase so the lost-demand-recovered metric is accurate and idempotent on duplicate order-paid webhooks.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: order_external_id
columns.purpose: dedup key — one conversion event per paid order

columns.name: send_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_sends(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the notification send that is credited with this conversion

tables.name: email_template
tables.purpose: Stores the merchant's editable email subject and body template used for all back-in-stock notification emails.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: singleton row guard — code enforces at most one row

columns.name: subject_template
columns.purpose: handlebars-style template supporting {{product_name}}, {{variant_title}} variables

columns.name: body_template
columns.purpose: handlebars-style template supporting {{product_name}}, {{variant_title}}, {{product_url}}, {{unsubscribe_url}} variables

tables.name: app_settings
tables.purpose: Stores merchant-configured operational settings: quiet-hours window and delivery batch size.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: singleton row guard — code enforces at most one row

columns.name: quiet_hours_start
columns.purpose: hour of day (0-23) at which quiet period begins; sends are held until quiet_hours_end

columns.name: quiet_hours_end
columns.purpose: hour of day (0-23) at which quiet period ends and held sends are released

columns.name: batch_size
columns.purpose: maximum number of emails to dispatch per schedule tick to avoid rate-limit spikes

tables.name: demand_snapshots
tables.purpose: Pre-aggregated per-variant demand metrics refreshed on each notification run creation and each new signup, enabling instant-load admin dashboard without full-table scans.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: the variant these metrics describe

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: parent product for grouping by product on the dashboard

columns.name: product_title
columns.purpose: denormalized for dashboard display without a product lookup

columns.name: variant_title
columns.purpose: denormalized for dashboard display

columns.name: active_signup_count
columns.purpose: number of signups with status=active; dashboard ranking key

columns.name: total_notified
columns.purpose: cumulative dispatched sends across all runs

columns.name: total_converted
columns.purpose: cumulative conversions attributed to notifications

columns.name: last_restock_at
columns.purpose: timestamp of the most recent notification run for this variant

columns.name: snapshot_updated_at
columns.purpose: when this row was last recalculated; used to detect stale snapshots

widget.purpose: Return whether the requested variant is out of stock and whether the given email is already signed up
Record a shopper's email on the waitlist for a specific variant; duplicate signups are silently ignored
Remove a shopper from all their active waitlists via the one-click unsubscribe token

admin.purpose: Return a paginated list of variants ranked by active signup count for the merchant demand dashboard
Return a paginated list of individual subscribers for a specific variant
Stream a properly-escaped CSV of all active subscribers for a given variant
Return a paginated history of notification runs
Return the current email subject and body template
Persist updated email subject and body template text
Return current quiet-hours start/end times and batch size
Persist updated quiet-hours window and delivery batch size
